metaTitle: AEO for Business Websites: Buyer Questions, Answers & Measurement
metaDescription: Understand answer engine optimization and how to evaluate an AEO agency: useful answers, credible evidence, crawlable links and honest measurement.
title: AEO for business websites: answer buyer questions clearly
excerpt: Choose commercially relevant buyer questions, answer them directly and measure the outcome without promising a search placement.
intro: Answer engine optimization, or AEO, is a practical way to organize useful answers to buyer questions so people and retrieval systems can understand them. Service providers use the term in different ways; ask which search or AI experience they mean and how they measure it.

For a business website, begin with clear answers, readable evidence and crawlable links. AEO, GEO and SEO overlap. Google’s AI-feature guidance does not require a separate optimization system or special markup. Visibility and inclusion cannot be guaranteed.

sections.heading: Why bother with a result nobody clicks
paragraphs: The obvious objection is that a zero-click answer produces no traffic, so why optimise for it.

Two reasons. First, brand attribution: answers frequently name their source, and being repeatedly named as the authority on a question compounds even without the visit. Second, the questions worth winning are the ones where the answer alone is not enough — a definition can be answered in a sentence, but a decision cannot.
The mistake is targeting purely informational questions and then complaining about the lack of traffic. Target questions where the answer leads naturally to needing help.

sections.heading: Answer the question in the first two sentences
paragraphs: Put a useful direct answer close to the heading, then explain the conditions and evidence. This helps a reader understand the page without searching through introductory copy.
Use this as a writing practice, not a guarantee that an engine will extract the passage. If the answer depends on the product, market or contract terms, explain those limits immediately.

sections.heading: Match the question's actual phrasing
paragraphs: Use the vocabulary your buyers use in enquiries, sales conversations and observed search queries. Keep an evidence label for phrases proposed by the editorial team but not yet observed.
A clear question heading can help when the page answers that question. Do not force every heading into a keyword variant or imply that a synonym has verified search demand.
list: Write headings as questions where a question is what people ask
Use the vocabulary of the buyer, not the industry
Cover the follow-up question immediately after the first

sections.heading: Format for the answer type
paragraphs: Choose the format that makes the answer easiest to use: steps for a process, a table for a genuine comparison, and a paragraph for a short explanation.
The format should follow the information. Adding lists or tables does not establish eligibility for a particular search display.

sections.heading: Structured data for the questions you answer
paragraphs: Use supported structured data that describes the visible content. Article and breadcrumb information can describe an editorial guide; service information can describe an actual service.

Question headings and visible answers are useful without adding FAQ or HowTo markup everywhere. Verify current platform support before adding a schema type, and never promise a rich result or AI citation from markup.

sections.heading: Choose questions with commercial gravity
paragraphs: Prioritize questions whose answers help a buyer decide what to do next, such as why a website gets visits but no relevant enquiries. Broader definitions may still be useful, but their commercial role should be clear.
Measure the next steps separately: being cited, receiving a visit, saving an enquiry and qualifying an opportunity are different outcomes.

sections.heading: How AEO and GEO differ in practice
paragraphs: These labels overlap and are used differently by providers. AEO often emphasizes question-and-answer content; GEO often emphasizes how a business is represented in generated answers. Ask which platform and measurement method a supplier means.
The same accurate, accessible page can support both. Review evidence and referrals over a defined question set rather than assuming one mention means a universal ranking.

sections.heading: Questions to ask before hiring an AEO agency
paragraphs: Which buyer questions are in scope? Which existing pages should answer them? What facts need review by our product or sales team? How will we distinguish citations, referred visits and qualified enquiries? These questions are more useful than asking how many keyword variations will be inserted.

Keep answers visible in the page and make structured data agree with that content. Use the [GEO measurement guide](/blog/generative-engine-optimization-geo) for AI visibility and the [lead-tracking guide](/blog/ga4-lead-generation-tracking) for the commercial handoff.

takeaway: AEO is answering the question directly, in the format the question implies, using the words people actually say. Choose questions where being the authority creates demand rather than satisfying it completely.
